name: @lkbaba/mcp-server-gemini

tools.name: gemini_multimodal_query
tools.description: Query using images + text for multimodal understanding. Analyze designs, diagrams, screenshots, or any visual content with natural language questions.

prompt.description: Question or instruction about the images

images.description: Images as file paths (e.g., ./images/screenshot.png) or Base64 data URIs. File paths will be automatically converted to Base64.

context.description: Optional: Additional context for better understanding

model.description: Gemini model to use (optional, default: gemini-3.1-pro-preview)

tools.name: gemini_analyze_content
tools.description:
Analyze code, documents, or data. Supports file path or direct content input. Provides summarization, code review, explanation, optimization, and debugging. Auto-detects content type and programming language.

TIP: This tool supports PARALLEL calls - analyze multiple files simultaneously for faster results.

content.description: Content to analyze (direct input). Use this or filePath.

filePath.description: File path to read and analyze (e.g., "./src/utils/parser.ts"). The tool will automatically read the file and detect the language. Use this or content.

language.description: Optional: Programming language (if code). Auto-detected when using filePath.

focus.description: Optional: Specific areas to focus on (e.g., ["security", "performance"])

model.description: Gemini model to use (optional, default: gemini-3.1-pro-preview)

tools.name: gemini_analyze_codebase
tools.description: Analyze entire codebase using 1M token context. Supports directory path, file paths, or file contents. Provides architecture overview, identifies patterns, security issues, performance bottlenecks, and dependency problems.

directory.description: Directory path to analyze (e.g., "./src" or "C:/Project/src"). The tool will automatically read files from this directory.

include.description: Glob patterns to include files (e.g., ["**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx"]). Only used with directory parameter.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude files (e.g., ["node_modules/**", "**/*.test.ts"]). Only used with directory parameter.

filePaths.description: List of file paths to analyze (e.g., ["./src/index.ts", "./src/utils/helper.ts"]). The tool will automatically read these files.

files.description: List of files with their content (for backward compatibility). Use directory or filePaths for easier usage.

deepThink.description: Enable Deep Think mode for complex analysis (default: false)

thinkingLevel.description: Thinking depth: low for speed, high for complex analysis (default: high)

model.description: Gemini model to use (optional, default: gemini-3.1-pro-preview)

tools.name: gemini_brainstorm
tools.description: Generate creative ideas and solutions. Provides multiple ideas with pros/cons and feasibility assessment. Supports reading project context files to generate ideas that fit your project.

contextFilePath.description: Path to project context file (e.g., README.md, PRD.md). Ideas will be tailored to fit the project.

model.description: Gemini model to use (optional, default: gemini-3.1-pro-preview)

tools.name: gemini_search
tools.description:
Search the web using Gemini's built-in Google Search grounding.

Features:
- Returns up-to-date information with source citations
- Supports thinkingLevel for reasoning depth control
- Ideal for: current events, latest documentation, real-time data, fact-checking

Usage Tips:
- Use thinkingLevel: 'low' for simple queries (faster response)
- Use thinkingLevel: 'high' for complex analysis (deeper reasoning)
- Use outputFormat: 'json' when you need structured data
- Search results include source URLs in groundingMetadata
- PARALLEL CALLS SUPPORTED: Search multiple queries simultaneously for faster results

query.description: Search query or question to answer using web search

context.description: Optional: Additional context to help refine the search

thinkingLevel.description: Thinking depth: low for speed, high for complex analysis (default: high)

outputFormat.description: Output format: text for readable response, json for structured data (default: text)

model.description: Gemini model to use (optional, default: gemini-3.5-flash for faster search)
